items.description:
Item type taxonomy of the inbox API --- the `types` filter of the public OpenAPI and MCP item search. The backend expands each value into the source labels the queried network actually indexes: `ORGANIC_COMMENT` becomes `comment` on YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn and Threads, `RATING` becomes `review` on Google.

Coverage per network:

* **Facebook:** adsComment, organicComment, conversation, mention, rating, profileComment, profileMessage
* **Instagram:** adsComment, organicComment, conversation, reelComment, mention, storyMentionConversation, profileComment, profileMessage
* **Twitter:** mention, conversation, profileComment, profileMessage
* **LinkedIn:** adsComment, organicComment, mention, profileComment
* **TikTok:** adsComment, organicComment, profileComment
* **Threads:** organicComment, mention, profileComment
* **YouTube:** organicComment, profileComment
* **Google:** rating, profileComment

`profileComment` and `profileMessage` are the only outgoing values --- what the profile itself
published in reply. Every other value is incoming, and several values are matched as a union.
x-enum-descriptions: Comments on promoted/sponsored posts (ads). Supported by: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok
Organic comments (not on ads). Supported by: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Threads, YouTube
Private messages / direct messages. Supported by: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter
Mentions of the profile/page. Supported by: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, Threads
Comments on Instagram Reels. Supported by: Instagram only

Conversations from story mentions. Supported by: Instagram only Note: This is different from the 'storyMention' source used in automated moderation rules. In the UI filters, this represents conversations grouped by story mentions.

Replies published by the profile itself: comment replies, and review replies on Google. Supported by every network.

On Twitter it also matches the profile's own published tweets, which carry the same
`userStatus` source as its replies. Combine with `parentIds` to keep the replies only.

On Threads it only matches replies indexed once `accountComment` started being written: the
older ones carry the profile umbrella alone, which is shared with every other item the profile posts.
Private messages sent by the profile itself. Supported by: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter
